thread:
Alex K: :rotating_light: Seeing a spike in 5xxs on /v2/prompt-route (new endpoint canary). Metric link: https://dash.re/redwood/alerts/994 — roughly 10–15% error rate since 02:10 UTC. Canopy customers reporting failures.
incident-bot: Paging Jordan (oncall). Sev2 triggered: prompt-router-canary-errors. Runbook: /incidents/runbooks/prompt-routing.md
Jordan (oncall): Acked. Jumping in. Maya, can you confirm customer impact?
Maya P: Confirmed — a subset of hosted API calls hit 502s, latency also spiked ~600ms p95. A couple of larger tenants have alerts. This looks correlated with the new routing logic we rolled at 02:00.
Samir R: Yep that canary shipped routing changes that prefer new_endpoint for short-context prompts. I see a pattern: kv-cache miss + new kernel path === rare NPE in adapter -> 5xx. Patch in progress but not ready. Recommend kill-switch to route canary back to legacy/v1_endpoint immediately.
Jordan (oncall): Agreed. What's the exact FF key and toggle command?
Samir R: FF key: prompt_router.new_endpoint.canary. Use the admin CLI:
```
redwood-ctl feature-flags set prompt_router.new_endpoint.canary false --scope canary --actor "oncall:Jordan"
```
That will flip the canary slice back to legacy routing. Watch /v2/prompt-route errors and canary traffic.
Alex K: Running the toggle now.
Alex K: command output: {"status":"ok","changed":true,"key":"prompt_router.new_endpoint.canary","value":false} :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Feature flag change recorded by Alex K at 2026-03-15T02:14:05Z. Triggering autoscan of affected buckets.
Maya P: Errors falling back toward baseline. p95 latency trending down. Rolling averages show recovery beginning at 02:15 UTC.
Jordan (oncall): Nice. Temporary mitigation worked. Samir — will you hold the hotfix branch for the adapter NPE? We should prevent re-rollout until fix + unit.
Samir R: Yes holding and writing a small fix. I'll run the adapter regression locally and post test logs.
Riley (product): Thanks for the fast response team. Customer impact window looks ~14 minutes for some tenants. We should notify CS with timeline and plan a postmortem. Also consider adding an automatic kill-switch when adapter errors exceed X/sec.
Jordan (oncall): Good call. Action items: 1) Samir: hotfix + tests, 2) Maya: gather customer request ids and error samples, 3) Alex: prepare short incident blurb for status page, 4) Riley: coordinate CS comms. I'll keep this thread open until docs + blurb are posted.
Alex K: Drafting blurb now, will post to status in ~10m.
Maya P: Uploading sample logs to the incident bucket: s3://incidents/1945678901/logs.
Samir R: Patch PR opened: https://git.re/redwood/serving/pulls/4782 — adding adapter-null-check + unit.
Jordan (oncall): Closing the active page in 15m if no regression. Leave channel for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
